name: Deep Agents
tagline: An agent framework and monorepo for planning, coding agents, tools, and partner integrations.
hook: Keeps global rules short by routing to scoped guides, and rejects tests that merely restate the current implementation.
summary: Deep Agents keeps shared constraints at the root and moves architecture, development, releases, and package work to focused guides. The root rules cover warning filters, API compatibility, repository searches, and generated reference material.

techniques.title: Reject tests that only freeze implementation shape
techniques.body: Tests must assert visible behavior, not incidental call order. A refactor that preserves behavior should not require mechanical test changes.
techniques.quote: Refactors that preserve behavior should not require mechanical test updates; rewrite or remove tests that do.

techniques.title: Match suppression scope to the actual exception
techniques.body: A single Ruff violation gets an inline suppression with a reason; file-wide ignores are reserved for categorical policies. The rule makes unjustified suppression a signal to reconsider the code.
techniques.quote: Do not hide a single violation with a file-wide ignore. If you cannot justify a suppression, the code is probably the problem.

techniques.title: Keep generated context below source evidence
techniques.body: The optional OpenWiki index is available just in time, but its unknowns are not new requirements. Source and tests remain authoritative, and normal updates happen by changing those inputs.
techniques.quote: - Treat source code and tests as authoritative. A brief's unknowns and review items are verification gaps, not automatic requirements.

techniques.title: Constrain searches to the relevant package
techniques.body: The routing section names SDK, coding-agent, ACP, eval, and partner paths. It excludes environment and generated trees from normal work and asks agents to locate the exact dependency file instead of searching every installed package.
techniques.quote: For dependency internals, find the exact environment file instead of searching all of `site-packages`.

techniques.title: Preserve anchors that other configuration depends on
techniques.body: The warnings section is not only prose: package configuration comments refer to its heading. The guide explicitly asks editors to keep that name stable.
techniques.quote: Keep this heading stable: package `pyproject.toml` comments cite it by name.

steal: Test behavior that should survive refactoring.
Keep individual suppressions local and justified.
Treat generated summaries as context with explicit authority limits.
Give agents narrow search roots for each subsystem.
Protect documentation anchors that configuration cites.
outline: Global development guidelines for the Deep Agents monorepo
